execution: Two sequential six-pair campaigns; no overlapping build, test, profiling, or separate archival/audit work by this agent. The runner validates/compresses between timed processes.
latency_quantiles: Pooled arrivals per variant/campaign; nearest rank ceil(p*N). Observed distributions, not paired confidence estimates or real-time guarantees.
validation: 333 Rust library/integration/doc tests plus 2 replay-example tests, Python 23, all-target Clippy, fmt, Rustdoc, 46 zero-fuzz source-only rollback stages.
